Time to meet the you who speaks perfectly — in your own voice. One minute of reading is all it takes.
Use the phone\'s mic — or a better one.
The better the mic, the better the voice that comes out. A wired mic is best if you have one.
Take your earbuds out before recording
Clothes soak up the echo, so the recording comes out clean. No closet? A curtain or a parked car works too. Start once the readings below go quiet.
It\'s built and it\'s yours. Sign in and it stays — with your progress, on whichever phone you use.
Clipping detected — move a little further from the mic.
Noisy background — try a quieter spot (a closet works great).
Some background noise — quieter is better.
Quiet take — we\'ll boost it, but closer to the mic helps.
Export or import this device\'s practice
A backup moves your practice between installs — and between phones.
Your voice model is built by the most trusted service there is, and used for your language practice only.
Your voice model is biometric data. It\'s used only to speak your practice lines back in your own voice — never sold, never shared, never used to train anyone else\'s model.
Your voice model is deleted here and at ElevenLabs, and this can\'t be undone. You\'ll be asked to record a new one before your next call.

This deletes your voice model here and at ElevenLabs. Audio already generated keeps playing until you delete your account. The app can\'t hold a call without a voice, so it will ask you to record a new one — or you can delete your account entirely.
Write to us to see or correct what we hold about you, including the date you gave consent.
This permanently deletes your voice clone, talk time, and account. It cannot be undone. An active Google Play subscription must be canceled separately in the Play Store.
Make me sound more like you
The more I know your life, the more real every talk feels. Just talk — your native language is fine.

The name other learners will see — first name or nickname is plenty.
Write it in %1$s — it\'s what “you” will talk from, and writing it is practice too. The specific beats the polished: your job, your town, the thing you\'d actually talk about for an hour.
A stock voice that plays “you” — your cloned voice is never used, and nobody\'s talks with your persona are ever shown to you or anyone else.
